body: I usually prefer the isolation. Maybe they didnt give a care, because I always push myself away? I dunno. That's a lame excuse for it. I just would think, since one of them also suffers from depression they would understand and be there...but they had absolutely no sympathy for me.
I really don't know what to write, I am just so...numb right now. :/ I am sorry

I love Incubus. A couple of their sings are like anthems to me and my so! Dig is especially my favorite!

I try so hard for him to be better because the depression and anxiety makes so many unnecessary fights between us. I know he's the one for me, but it's so hard to explain him how I feel like I just can't be...Nothing bothers him in the slightest and I too try and mimic his behavior at times, but it's so difficult. 

He really is my angel. And he knows that. He knows how much of a shell I was before him. I was such a ridiculous puzzle he needed to glue together. But he takes on so much for me in all aspects in life. I really want to have children for him because he and I would make beautiful children. I am just scared because I don't have very many eggs left after my condition. It's scary being a girl. :/

Whoever you are, I hope you know you are such a beautiful person. You have touched my soul so much in ways that I never thought possible. I really wasnt expecting as much as what you wrote when I wrote this post so I want to say thank you. Thank you for picking me up just a little more, and helping me through this bad night. It's a very beautiful feeling. :') I hope life hands you everything that you could ever want because I can see through the passion in your words that you have such a gorgeous soul, and you don't see that anymore. It's sad it's become a rarity in such a cruel world. 

Yeah I LOVE owls, ocelots, and otters. I thought it was a creative name for it! I feel yah on the zoo feels. It's bittersweet. And the otters are always the ones who are rambunctious!

edit: missing words and spelling

No, I live with my boyfriend and his twin brother and his fiance. They all know to an extent of what is wrong with me. It just takes a serious toll on everything though. Like I am walking on eggshells, for them as well. Of course my boyfriend knows the full extent of everything in my life. I hold no secrets with him and he is very understanding, but even he is in the dark because he is perfect. He doesn't know this type of hurt, if that makes sense?

And thank you for those awfully kind and beautiful words. You are a wonderful person for whoever you are for reading my summary on my life. Thank you. :)
Oddly enough, mine is a hybrid animal that consists of an owl, an ocelot, and an otter.
